children: Sean D Keohane, a Director serving as President and CEO, reported a direct sale of 134,895 shares of Common Stock at $85.00 per share on August 28, 2026, for a total of $11,466,075. The report lists the total sale amount as $11,466,075 and the selling price per share as $85.00. Following the transaction, Keohane directly owns 404,134 shares and indirectly owns 14,263 shares through the trustee for the corporation's 401(k) plan. A footnote states that 137,674 shares were subject to an option that vested 30% on November 9, 2019, 30% on November 9, 2020, and 40% on November 9, 2021.
